## 🚀 Problem Statement or Motivation
Is your feature request related to a specific challenge or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. *"I'm building an enterprise dashboard and need a date range picker with preset buttons..."*)

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or new component you'd like to see added.

### Proposed Component API & Example
```tsx
import { ProposedComponent } from '@alcspower/ui';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ProposedComponent variant="primary" size="md">
      Content
    </ProposedComponent>
  );
}
```

## 🎨 Visual Aesthetics & Design Alignment
How does this proposal fit into the **Modern SaaS / Craft Minimalist** aesthetic of `@alcspower/ui`? (e.g. hairline borders, generous radii, soft depth, cool indigo palette).

## ♿ Accessibility Considerations (WAI-ARIA)
- What keyboard interactions should be supported (`Tab`, `Escape`, `Arrow keys`)?
- What ARIA roles and attributes are required?

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.
